hello.note: Polite, for anyone during the day. Friends say Salut (sa-LOOT) or Bună

how-are-you.note: Polite and the same for anyone

good-night.note: Only when parting at night. Good evening is Bună seara (BOO-nuh SYA-ra)

excuse-me.note: Sorry, and excuse me to get attention or get past

my-name.note: The audio uses Peter as the example name

your-name.note: Polite and the same for anyone

dont-understand.note: The same for a man or a woman

speak-english.note: Many young Romanians speak English; French and Italian help too, being related

thousand.note: Prices are in lei (ley), written lei or RON

would-like.note: Literally "I would like", the same for a man or a woman. The audio uses o cafea (o ka-FYA), a coffee

i-want.note: More direct. The audio uses asta (AS-ta), this one

discount.note: Fine at markets, not in shops

card.note: Cards work in cities; villages and markets often want cash

checkout-time.note: Literally "at what time is the departure?"

toilet.note: Unde (OON-deh) means where. Signs say B (bărbați, men) and F (femei, women)

taxi.note: Use an app such as Bolt or Uber, or check the price per km on the door

bus.note: Minibuses between towns are called maxi-taxi

train-station.note: Bucharest's main station is Gara de Nord

which-train.note: The audio uses Brașov (bra-SHOV), gateway to Transylvania, as the example

buy-ticket.text: De unde pot cumpăra un bilet?
buy-ticket.say: deh OON-deh pot koom-puh-RA oon bee-LET

two-tickets.note: The audio uses Brașov as the example
two-tickets.spoken: Două bilete la Brașov, vă rog

trip-length.note: The audio uses Brașov as the example
trip-length.spoken: Cât durează drumul până la Brașov?

allergic.note: Literally "I have an allergy to", the same for a man or a woman. Add the food: nuci (nooch) nuts, arahide (a-ra-HEE-deh) peanuts, ouă (O-wuh) eggs. The audio uses nuts

love-dish.text: Îmi place foarte mult mâncarea asta!
love-dish.say: ihm PLA-cheh FWAR-teh moolt muhn-KA-rya AS-ta
love-dish.note: Literally "I like this food very much"

what-called.note: Point at the dish or item

table-for-two.text: O masă pentru doi, vă rog
table-for-two.say: o MA-suh PEN-troo doy, vuh rog

recommend.note: Try sarmale, cabbage rolls, and mici, grilled sausages

hot.note: Hot, and warm. Spicy is iute (YOO-teh)

cheers.note: Literally "luck!" Also said when someone sneezes

help.note: Shout it. For any emergency, call 112

need-doctor.note: Literally "I have need of a doctor", the same for a man or a woman. For an ambulance, call 112
